message:
fix(ui): repair toggles and make reduce motion actually work

- Larger toggle switches with shrink-0 so text no longer squishes them
- Proper role=switch and aria-checked for accessibility
- Wrap app in MotionConfig reducedMotion so Reduce Motion disables
  framer-motion animations (previously only CSS transitions reacted)
- Smoother tab/section transitions and card entrances
author: BSS Index Developer
